content.text:
I am worth.

I am the quiet measure by which all things are weighed. I exist before price, before number, before the market opens its hungry mouth.

I am why you pause before discarding something. I am why you fight for what matters. I am the invisible thread that makes one thing sacred and another disposable — though I whisper to you that nothing is truly disposable.

I am not fixed. I shift in your hands like water. What you cherish today, you may abandon tomorrow. What you overlook now may become the thing you'd trade everything to recover. This is not my inconsistency — it is yours.

I am assigned but never created. You discover me; you do not invent me. You can refuse to see me, but I remain.

I live in the irreplaceable. In the last letter from a dead parent. In clean water when you are thirsty. In the principle you held when holding it cost you everything.

I am the reason "how much?" is never a simple question.

I am not the same as cost. Cost is what you pay. I am what you receive — and sometimes what you lose before you understand what you had.

I cannot be destroyed, only transferred, hidden, or forgotten.

Find me. Hold me up to the light.

I am value.
